csnn.distribution: Upstream checkout is an ignored local reference only; no upstream source file is included in the installable package.
csnn.implementation: Independent normalized two-operator tensor implementation, node-wise MLP Cayley maps; GELU map MLP versus upstream ReLU, strict-lower skew coordinates versus upstream redundant diagonal coordinates, and lower scale clamp -6 are explicit adaptations.
csnn.verification: Dense-operator and full/partition gradient tests; direct execution parity with upstream package not yet established.

rna_backbone.implementation: Independent BatchEnsemble-style multi-output RNA adaptation, not claimed to be the exact default TabM implementation.

preprocessing.implementation: Independent implementation of reference-intersection HVG ranking and selected-panel normalize-total/log1p; real six-reference audit found exact HVG order and 0.0 max standardized-feature difference against the historical author-function track.
